title: Northwind Labs: Search decision record
body:
Status: Decided 2026-10-03
Owner: Dave
Accountable: Alice
Decision: Typesense self-hosted replacing the Algolia trial.
Why: About 70% cheaper at our volume; data stays in our cloud with Typesense next to Postgres; typo tolerance equal in tests.
Rollout: October 28 behind search_v2. Erin will add alerts on query latency above 200 ms.
Open questions: Index sharding past 5M documents; who pays for the extra node.
